# Short Obligatory Prayer
## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon.

O me Nyankopɔn, Midi Adanse sɛ Wo na Woabɔ me sɛ min hu Wo na mensom Wo. Midi adanse wɔsaa dɔn yi mu sɛ me de memfra na wo na Wowɔ tumi, meyɛ ohiani na Wo na Wo yɛ Ɔdefo. O Nyame bi nni baabi sɛ Wo nkutoo Korɛ Ahohia mu Boafo ne Onyame aƆnnan obi.
